blocks.text: SACRAMENTO, California — Keegan Murray’s putback over three defenders with 5 seconds left lifted the Sacramento Kings to a 97-96 victory over the Boston Celtics on Saturday. The Kings snapped an eight-game losing streak and earned their first home win this season following the back-and-forth game down the stretch. Trailing by one with 11.8 seconds left, Darius Acuff Jr. drove the lane and his shot was off. Murray grabbed the putback and scored to give the Kings the one-point advantage.
